'''2014 Philadelphia Premiere Mike d'Amboise LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike d'Amboise]] at [[2014 Philadelphia Premiere Event]].

* '''Player:''' [[Mike d'Amboise]]
